name: @magpie-community/page-credit-balance
description: Track provider credit spend, compare peak and off-peak token estimates, and convert balances to a reference provider's credits in Magpie.

summary.en: Match model names across providers, compare peak and off-peak token estimates, convert balances to one provider's credits, and review 24-hour, 7-day and 30-day spend by provider and model.
summary.zh: 自选跨供应商型号映射，对比高峰和低峰可用 Token，把余额折算为同一家积分，并按供应商和型号查看 24 小时、7 日和 30 日消耗。
